ready1_open_rewrite.title: SciVerse open question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: On a previously unknown island, 5 new insect species were discovered. A proteomic analysis was performed on highly conserved proteins of these insects, and the number of amino acid sequence differences among them was calculated. Scientists constructed a phylogenetic tree based on these data, with nodes I, II, III, IV and O, P, Q, R, S labeled on the tree. According to the given information, which pair of insect species has the most shared derived characters?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: On a previously unknown island, 5 new insect species were discovered. A proteomic analysis was performed on highly conserved proteins of these insects, and the number of amino acid sequence differences among them was calculated. Scientists constructed a phylogenetic tree based on these data, with nodes I, II, III, IV and O, P, Q, R, S labeled on the tree. According to the given information, which pair of insect species has the most shared derived characters?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left is a phylogenetic tree, with endpoints labeled O, P, Q, R, S and internal nodes labeled I, II, III, IV; the figure does not directly show which insect O, P, Q, R, S respectively correspond to. The table on the right lists the numbers of amino acid sequence differences among 5 insects, Snippeiq, Fixxels, Snorflak, Gerdellen, and Sqellert, among which the number of differences between Fixxels and Snorflak is 3. There is more than one combination in the table whose number of differences is 3; for example, Snippeiq and Snorflak, and Snippeiq and Sqellert are also 3. Reasoning: The question asks which pair of insects has the most shared derived characters, not the largest number of differences. When phylogenetic relationships are constructed from conserved protein sequences, the fewer the amino acid sequence differences, the closer the relationship, and usually the more shared derived characters. The number of differences between Fixxels and Snorflak is 3, which is one of the species pairs with the smallest number of differences in the table, so it can be used as a pair having the most shared derived characters. Answer: Snorflak and Fixxels.
